name: Sovereignty
overview: Scripture reveals the sovereignty of God as absolute and all-encompassing, affirming that He rules over all creation with complete authority and freedom to do as He pleases, as seen in Psalms 103:19 and Psalms 115:3. God's sovereign power extends to every realm—heaven, earth, seas, and the depths—demonstrating His unchallengeable dominion (Psalms 135:6). While man may devise plans, it is ultimately the Lord who directs and establishes the course of human steps and counsel, underscoring the interplay between human responsibility and divine sovereignty (Proverbs 16:9; Proverbs 19:21). This understanding anchors our confidence in God's perfect control over all thoughts and actions (Job 42:2).
